description: Apple Inc. designs, manufactures and markets smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories, and sells a variety of related services. Its products include iPhone smartphones based on the iOS operating system, Mac personal computers based on macOS, iPad multipurpose tablets based on iPadOS, Apple Watch, AirPods and Beats products, Apple Vision Pro, its spatial computer based on visionOS, and Home products including Apple TV 4K, HomePod and HomePod mini. Its services include advertising through third-party licensing arrangements and its own advertising platforms, a portfolio of fee-based AppleCare service and support products, and cloud services that store and keep customers' content up to date and available across multiple Apple devices and Windows personal computers.
